info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for the Ecommerce Platform. All endpoints are accessed through the API Gateway which acts as a reverse proxy to backend microservices (Identity Service, Product Service, Order Service, etc.). The Gateway automatically forwards cookies, headers, and user context to backend services.
info.title: Ecommerce Platform API Gateway

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT access token. Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly cookie containing JWT access token. Automatically set after login/register. Used for authentication in browser-based applications.
CookieAuth.name: access_token
